name: Zver
desc: The leader of the bio-alchemically created monsters in service of the Belyi Tsar.

customize.name: Koshchei
customize.desc: A bio-alchemist and researcher from Hvergelmir. He is also known as Doctor Moreau.

customize.text: Using bio-alchemy, Koshchei created a number of "prototypes" using the same materials, and of these prototypes, only Zver and Proto-Man showed intelligence. Koshchei considered Zver a half-formed creation and therefore abandoned him. In the end, that unfinished form was fused with the seeds of other monsters.

customize.name: Belyi Tsar
customize.desc: Monomakh Snezhnyi was the Tsar of all Fae and the first Cryo Archon.
